preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Each test case has an n between 1 and 100,000.
The total sum of all n values across all test cases does not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output[i], list) and len(output[i]) == ns[i] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a list of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(p[j], int) and 0 <= p[j] < ns[i] for j in range(ns[i])) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each element in the permutation is an integer between 0 and n-1.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(output[i])) == ns[i] for i in range(t))
all((output[i][j] + j)**0.5 == int((output[i][j] + j)**0.5) for i in range(t) for j in range(ns[i]))
postconditions.description: For each element in the permutation, the sum of the element and its index is a perfect square.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] != -1 or not any((k + j)**0.5 == int((k + j)**0.5) for k in range(ns[i]) for j in range(ns[i])) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: If no permutation exists, the output is -1.
